cases.name: Jessica Elaine Cyrus
cases.about: Her obituary said: "Jessica was the most loving and giving person we have ever had the pleasure of knowing. From emotional support in hard times to lending a hand when assistance was needed. She was a true inspiration of what family really means, going above and beyond no matter the hardship that follows. In every way, she was the string that tied us all together. We were very blessed to have been her family. Every inch of our home has her touch stamped on it. Her heart didn’t function without giving especially to family or friends."
